_README: Exceptions to the darts/ placement policy checked by
Every entry needs 'module', 'clause' and a written 'justification' of at
least 40 characters; the checker refuses to run on an entry without one, and
warns about entries whose module has been fixed or deleted, so the list
'status' is informational and takes one of:
seed        -- a deliberate library seed: general, documented, kept in the
package on purpose while its first consumer is written.
pre-existing -- debt inherited from `development`, older than the branch
that introduced this check. Recorded, not endorsed: every
one of these needs a maintainer decision (give it a CI-wired
consumer, or move it out of the installable package).
All entries below were verified to be flagged identically on the merge base
(development, 89679e42) -- this branch introduces none of them.

allow.justification: Abstract Conductivity base plus one correlation, part of the documented physics-properties API (docs/api.rst) but not imported by any model or test; every CI model builds conductivity inline instead. Pre-existing on development; needs a consumer or removal.

574-line DFM-well/reservoir line-graph plotter landed by an earlier pipes MR with no caller. The same class of file as the four plotters M0 adopted into the CI mains; it should get the same treatment, from a maintainer, in its own change.

Hard-coded FluidFlower rig geometry (case-specific coordinates), referenced only from docs/technical_reference/reservoir.md. Fails the generality clause as well; kept because removing it is a separate, pre-existing decision.

A __main__ demo script for the geometry shapes that ships inside the wheel and still uses implicit-relative imports ('from shapes import *'), so it cannot even be imported as darts.reservoirs.mesh.geometry.main. Pre-existing; belongs under models/ or docs/.
Numba/KDTree helper for mapping properties between meshes, general in shape but with no in-repo caller, so nothing in CI compiles its jitted kernels. Pre-existing on development.

UnstructRadialReservoir has no model or test; its structured sibling struct_radial_reservoir is exercised, this one is not. Pre-existing on development; a reservoir class with no coverage is a maintainer decision, not a review-time deletion.
Reader for AD-GPRS rate/HDF5 output, used for external benchmark comparisons that live outside this repository. Pre-existing on development; keep or move to a benchmarking repo is a maintainer call.
Standalone meshio-based vtu-to-msh converter, general and self-contained but with no in-repo caller and no test. Pre-existing on development.
Reader for Eclipse RSM-style rate tables, the input side of plot_eclipse; used for external benchmark comparisons that live outside this repository. Pre-existing on development.

Inverse of partition_domain in the fracture-network preprocessing chain; partition_domain is exercised by the fracture_network models, the merge half is not. Pre-existing on development; the natural fix is a unit test rather than deletion.

Debug helpers for the assembled BCSR Jacobian (check_jacobian, write/read pkl, plot_bcsr_matrix). General and genuinely useful during development, but no model or test calls them, so nothing in CI notices when the engine's Jacobian accessors change shape. Pre-existing on development; the natural fix is a unit test.
Matplotlib overlays of AD-GPRS results on DARTS plots, the plotting side of adgprs_io; used for external benchmark comparisons that live outside this repository. Pre-existing on development.
Matplotlib overlays of Eclipse results on DARTS plots, the plotting side of eclipse_rates_io; used for external benchmark comparisons that live outside this repository. Pre-existing on development.
